# comp110_gui (bundled)

A copy of the COMP110 GUI library that Wildfire110's sketch table uses,
bundled here so the workspace can install it without access to its GitHub
repository. You do not need to read or change anything in this folder.

Source: iHinks/comp110_gui at commit 86ca3fe. To update it, re-run
tools/make_workspace.py in the Wildfire110 course repository.
